variantInfo.name: Aquanite
notes: Requires 78 Slayer and access to Ynysdail.
Attacks with accurate Magic and has a max hit of 18.
Slash severs the lure and reduces stab Defence from 60 to 10.
Can drop the Aquanite tendon used to make the Aquanite hopper.
Cannon cannot be used because the cavern floor is too damp.

variantInfo.name: Elder aquanite
notes: Superior Slayer monster unlocked by Bigger and Badder.
Spawns at a 1/200 rate after killing an Aquanite while on task.
Special attack deals 35 damage if Protect from Magic has been active for some time.
Flick Protect from Magic on and off between attacks to avoid taking damage.

locationComparison.name: Ynysdail Cavern
notes: Aquanites are found in Ynysdail Cavern beneath Ynysdail.
A Dwarf multicannon cannot be used because the ground is too damp.

taskNotes: Aquanites require 78 Slayer to kill and no combat level requirement.
Accessing Ynysdail requires 73 Sailing and a boat with an adamant keel or better.
To receive Aquanites as a Slayer task, players must first unlock Lured In for 80 Slayer reward points.
Nieve assigns 40-60 Aquanites and Duradel assigns 30-50 Aquanites.
Let's Stay All Aquanite extends Aquanite assignments to 150-200.
Aquanites can drop the Aquanite tendon used to make the Aquanite hopper.
Aquanites attack with Magic and have high accuracy, so Protect from Magic is highly recommended.
Aquanites are in single-way combat, and a Dwarf multicannon cannot be used because the ground is too damp.
slash attack severs the Aquanite lure, reducing stab Defence by 50 from 60 to 10; damage is not required to sever the lure.
Use a fast 4-tick slash weapon such as a scimitar or Abyssal whip to sever the lure before using stab weapons.
Saradomin godsword special attack can sever the lure if no other special attack weapon is brought.
Elder Aquanites can spawn at 1/200 on task after Bigger and Badder and require flicking Protect from Magic to avoid their 35-damage special.
For first-time access, sail manually to Ynysdail and build the rowboat hotspot.
Building the rowboat requires 70 Construction, hammer, saw, 10 swamp paste, and 8 camphor planks.
After the rowboat is built, travel is possible between Ynysdail and north of Gwenith; using that rowboat requires Song of the Elves.
recommendedMethod: Use Protect from Magic. Sever the Aquanite lure with a fast slash weapon such as Abyssal whip or a scimitar, then use strong stab melee such as Soulreaper axe, Ghrazi rapier, Osmumten's fang, Blade of saeldor, Abyssal dagger, or Voidwaker. Flick Protect from Magic against Elder aquanites.
